preconditions.description: The dimensions of the board and the minimum number of distinct positive numbers must be within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= board[i][j] <= n*m for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: All entries in the board must be within the range [-1, n*m].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= cost[i][j] <= 100000 for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: All costs must be within the range [1, 100000].

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(min_cost) if min_cost != -1 else stdout == '-1'
postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum cost if a valid block is found, otherwise -1.
The minimum cost must be non-negative if a valid block is found.

postconditions.expression: any(len(set(block)) >= K for block in valid_blocks)
postconditions.description: There must be at least one valid block with at least K distinct positive numbers.
